;; Browser-runtime adversarial capture cases R2-R12 and R15-R21b.

CLASS nonwall NOT "#="
CLASS walkable " -.O"
CLASS nonspace NOT " "

HIDDEN_LINE_CHAR %

GOAL
Z

0123456789ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz%#=?. -

BIND b probe c greedy d rollback e dynamic f nested g scoped h prewrite j random k last r repeat n notclass w whitespace s nonspace a anchor q question p hidden o rotate

CMD probe
 ATOMIC 1 AB
  1X 1E

CMD greedy
 ATOMIC 1 AB
  1- 1-

  1Z 1Z

CMD rollback
 ATOMIC 1 AB
  MATCH1
   1- 1x never!

   #1Q #1E

CMD dynamic
 ATOMIC 1 AB
  1- 1x literal_capture!

CMD nested
 ATOMIC 1 AB
  MATCH1
   ATOMIC
    1- 1x

    1Z 1Z

   #1- #1E

CMD scoped
 ATOMIC 1 AB
  ATOMIC 2 CD
   1a 1b

   2c 2d

  CALL independent_capture

  1q 1e

  2l 2e

  CALL literal_capture

CMD prewrite
 ATOMIC 1 AB
  MATCH1
   Z1 Z1

   Q- E1

CMD random
 ATOMIC 1 ABC
  1- 1E [random]

CMD last
 ATOMIC 1 ABC
  1- 1E [lastmatch]

CMD repeat
 ATOMIC 1 AB
  REPEAT
   1 1

  x- x1

CMD notclass
 ATOMIC 1 nonwall
  C1- C11

CMD whitespace
 ATOMIC 1 walkable
  C1- C11

CMD nonspace
 ATOMIC 1 nonspace
  C1- C11

CMD anchor
 ATOMIC 1 AB
  C1 CE

CMD question
 ATOMIC 1 nonwall
  C1- C11

  K1 KZ

CMD hidden
 ATOMIC 1 %
  C1- C11

CMD rotate
 ATOMIC 1 AB
  ROTATE
   X1 X1

  FLIP_HORIZONTAL
   Y1 Y1

CMD never
 ZZ ZZ

CMD literal_capture
 1z 1y

CMD independent_capture
 ATOMIC 1 CD
  1m 1n
